description: This file defines the class AOD_IndexViewIndexData, which extends SugarView and is responsible for displaying index data and related information in the SuiteCRM module AOD_Index. It includes methods for gathering module index counts, index file counts, and rendering a view with this data, including handling failed index events.

classes.name: AOD_IndexViewIndexData
classes.description: A class extending SugarView responsible for displaying index data and failed index events in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method that gathers index statistics, renders the index data template, and displays failed index events if any.
